author: Rob Sammore

settings.name: Initiative Formula
settings.hint: Formula used by the combat tracker: Dexterity modifier, initiative adjustments, and decimal tie-breaker.

settings.name: Initiative Tie-Breaker
settings.hint: Adds the decimal Dexterity score (DEX / 100) to initiative to break ties automatically.

settings.name: Maximum Hit Points at Level 1
settings.hint: New heroes receive the maximum hit points for their first level.

settings.name: Encumbrance Tracking
settings.hint: Applies the SRD optional carrying-capacity rule and its penalties for excess weight.

settings.name: Compact Chat Cards
settings.hint: Shows item rolls and activations in a compact format to save chat space.

settings.name: Milestone Advancement
settings.hint: Allows level advancement through story milestones instead of accumulated XP.

settings.name: Critical Hit Rule
settings.hint: Method used to calculate damage on critical hits.

settings.name: Death Saving Throw DC
settings.hint: Difficulty for death saving throws (the standard 5e value is 10).

settings.name: Diagonal Grid Movement
settings.hint: Rule used to count diagonal movement on the grid.

settings.name: Primary Party
settings.hint: Group actor used to calculate encounter difficulty.
